independentReproduction.note: Ran in an isolated copy so NO v1 evidence byte was modified.

classification.why: Counts 81 POIs / 210 rooms and checks roof count equals covered-room count. Does not test roof visibility, wall collision or opening access.
Checks roof polygon lies inside parent room bbox and status=PROPOSED. Bbox containment is weaker than polygon containment; no wall/opening/LOS test.
Asserts 10 proposed + 8 named blockers = 18 and that blockers have ID/conflict strings. It EXPLICITLY passes because blockers are documented, not because they are resolved.
Checks shaft CENTRE inside the overlap bbox. No collision, bidirectional traversal, boundary opening or LOS test.
Checks two POI examples are inspectable via poiGraph; not a physical access proof.
Counts blocked/clear direct LOS segments; does not connect LOS to room usability or roof occlusion.
Checks room polygon validity and ownership strings.
Invalid POI ID returns INVALID.
Chunk count/neighbour/digest checks; not a geometry-continuity sweep.
Checks stable feature IDs in chunk lists (first 40 crossing features); not all 579 and not boundary geometry.
Counts roads/bridges/docks and profile objects.
Passes because cartPassable=false and deckStatus=UNRESOLVED are recorded. It does not resolve any deck or swept clearance.
Compares centre clearance to 3 body widths; centreline only, no swept envelope.
Passes because 7 disconnected roads, 8 blocked ferries and crossing defects are preserved as strings.
Passes because alternate candidates exist and are non-canonical.
Passes because >0 envelopes have unresolved water overlap. The v1 overlap count (12) was itself WRONG (see build_sites_v2).
Counts spawns/homes/Elders and >=3 distinct signatures.
BFS reachability of nonboss route legs over dry land. Real spatial check.
Missing body width returns UNKNOWN.
Water-overlap envelope reports unresolved.
Window masks exist and chunk continuity flag is 0; five masks are NOT a complete EconomyMap.

verdict: v1 M-G3/M-G4 are predominantly COVERAGE / DOCUMENTATION passes; physical completion was NOT proven. v2 adds physical checks and keeps documentation PASS separate from VERIFIED_GEOMETRY.
